build_ms_dedicated_timing_pass.definitions:
T44c D-sign2 dedicated timing aggregation (single process, no other job of this verifier). p90 over pooled runs.
off = fine target-free tier build; on = fine + coarse target-free tier build (+ non-target points for `ball`, which the
pipeline computes only when the coarse tier is on; `ball_owned` computes them anyway).

gradient_layer_identity_mismatch.note: all 6 at value |v| <= 1.2e-9 m (seed voxel); bo_d3 2, oracle 4; ball 0

baseline_check.note: cuRobo 기준선: 위반으로 시작 10/15 · has_target 15/15 · frame0 clearance_before -9.171877401271193 mm — 기준값과 같다

verdict.reproduction: coarse off 의 target-free 값이 T44E2b raw 와 같은 frame 에서: distractor 내부 점 max |diff| 0.0 m (180,970 점 × 방식 3), 권한 구 / grid 는 max |diff| 5.07e-7 m (sign 차이 q 2 · grid 6–8 / 3.78M). safety off 수 (3895 점 · 54 frame, demo gt_label ball) 가 T44E2b 와 같다.
facts: timing pass 는 verifier S1 (serve_safe 2 · pi05_infer client 2) 과 겹쳐 돌았다 — pod_load 는 numbers.build_ms_dedicated_timing_pass.pooled.pod_load.

not_measured: pipeline identity with real VLA attention (GT Gaussian attention)
safe_policy verdict class for target_free_coarse rows (_NOT_TARGET_TIERS, impl.md 판정 1)
target exterior shell points (0-10 mm outside the target surface) as a separate set — only authorized spheres and grid offsets
build ms on an idle pod (S1 overlap)
deviations: oracle coarse tier is verifier-defined (harness has none): GT-target-labelled coarse seeds (voxel majority >= 80 %, harness voxel_labels with hulls) removed within ball + 20 mm, z unbounded; sign set = harness make_oracle rule at 20 mm voxel (removed seeds | non-seed with d_t < d_o - 20 mm); no shared-voxel preservation. Its counts dict has no n_sign_candidates (reported 0).
'_ns' coarse tiers (shared preservation disabled) built by passing no non-target points to the coarse spec; ball_owned classification still uses its OwnedEvidence non-target points.
AG3S config owned_max_dist_voxels 3.0 (T44E2b used 2.0 in config; fine tiers take d from OwnedEvidence explicitly, so the fine values are the same — reproduction above).

gtNT / gtT (GT nearest-surface distances of query centres) are unsigned to points (target signed by hull); the gtNT-based underestimate counts in agg_e2c.json also fire for OFF (e.g. demo gt_label q 1975/8640) and are not used in this verify.json.

gradient check: <= 4000 sampled points per frame × identity × method among points answered by target_free_coarse; FD of target_free_distance (h = 1 mm) vs target_free_gradient; reference = same measure on the coarse target-free layer alone and on the main coarse layer at the same points.
